bolt11_pay.note: Scanned/pasted invoices paid via LDK Node bolt11Payment().send

bolt11_receive.note: Receive screen shows BIP21 with an embedded bolt11 invoice

bolt12_pay.note: The app never calls bolt12Payment; offers fall through to 'Unsupported' toast

bolt12_receive.note: The app creates only bolt11 invoices, never offers

offline_receive.note: Blocktank push asks user to open app; extension doesn't start node

lnurl.note: LNURL-pay, withdraw, channel and auth all handled

ln_address_pay.note: bitkit-core decode turns user@domain into LNURL-pay (source not in scratchpad)

ln_address_receive.note: Receive offers only on-chain/bolt11; Pubky/Paykit profile keys are a separate system

bip353.note: No DNS/HRN resolution in fork or app; user@domain resolves as LNURL

mpp.note: LDK router splits payments automatically, up to 10 paths by default

keysend.note: App uses spontaneous only for probes in the hidden dev settings

choose_peer.note: Default LSP is Blocktank; manual open to any node URI, or LNURL-channel from other LSPs

jit_channels.note: Blocktank CJIT on receive, plus paid orders for inbound liquidity

splicing.note: App only logs splice events and never calls spliceIn/spliceOut

anchors.note: Anchor channels config is set, with zero reserve for trusted Blocktank peers

local_pathfinding.note: Local LDK routing using Blocktank RGS snapshot and Blocktank-hosted scorer

watchtower.note: No watchtower client configured in app or offered by LDK Node

channel_backup.note: All LDK state stored remotely in Synonym VSS server (bitkit.to)

onchain_independent.note: LDK Node's single-key on-chain wallet; sends do not involve Blocktank

taproot.note: Selectable address type in Advanced settings; default is native segwit

multisig.note: Only single-sig address types; no multisig or shared accounts found

hw_signer.note: Trezor pairing (BLE); on-chain sends and transfers signed on device

coin_control.note: Manual coin selection mode lets user pick UTXOs for on-chain sends

tor.note: No Tor code; UI string says 'Bitkit cannot add Tor nodes'
